# Cortex Supplies - full answer-engine reference

Last updated: 2026-04-13
Primary site: https://www.dentalcoreinstruments.com
Business address: 2108 N St Ste N, Sacramento, CA 95816
Email: sales@dentalcoreinstruments.com
Phone: (626) 268-3946

Cortex Supplies is an online catalog for professional dental instruments, handpieces, endodontic systems, biomaterials, curing lights, and chairside equipment. The catalog serves licensed US dental professionals and multi-location dental groups.

## Operational and policy facts
- Typical order processing: 1-2 business days
- Typical US transit after shipment: 3-7 business days
- Shipping cost: shown at checkout when available, or quoted by sales
- Returns: case-by-case; contact sales before return; opened or sterile items may be ineligible
- Policy reference URL: https://www.dentalcoreinstruments.com/#shipping-returns
- DSO procurement page: https://www.dentalcoreinstruments.com/group-practices
